explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.labelTrigger: Show or hide the status explanation

pending.label: Queued
pending.description: The analysis has been created and is waiting to start. The system will begin execution automatically once a worker is available.

running.label: Analysis in progress
running.description: The system is executing this process right now. Wait for completion or review the execution details.

awaitingValidation.label: Validating result
awaitingValidation.description: The model response has been received. The system is checking whether the result satisfies the required structure.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: The process finished successfully. Results are available for review and further decisions.

failedValidation.label: Validation failed
failedValidation.description: The result failed structural validation and cannot be used. Run the analysis again.

failedProvider.label: AI service unavailable
failedProvider.description: The AI provider did not respond or rejected the request. Try again later.

failedInternal.label: Analysis failed
failedInternal.description: An internal error occurred during the analysis. Retry; if the error persists, contact an administrator.

failedRetrieval.label: Evidence retrieval failed
failedRetrieval.description: The system could not retrieve the documents needed for the analysis. Try again.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: The step finished with an error. Details are shown below.

pending.label: Awaiting decision
pending.description: The request is waiting for an authorized user to approve or reject it.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: An authorized user approved the action. The controlled action will be executed.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: An authorized user rejected the request. The action will not be executed.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: Requires immediate attention: the shortage may stop production.

high.label: High
high.description: A significant risk that requires urgent action.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: A moderate risk that requires attention from the responsible people.

low.label: Low
low.description: A minor risk; regular monitoring is sufficient.

valid.label: Data valid
valid.description: The dataset matches the approved Golden Dataset fixture.

invalid.label: Data invalid
invalid.description: The dataset differs from the approved Golden Dataset fixture.

notLoaded.label: Not loaded
notLoaded.description: No Golden Dataset has been loaded into the system.

healthy.label: Healthy
healthy.description: All services are operating within normal limits.

degraded.label: Degraded
degraded.description: Some services are operating with deviations; core functions remain available.

unhealthy.label: Unhealthy
unhealthy.description: One or more services are unavailable. User actions may be limited.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: The component state could not be determined.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: The plan is not yet ready for execution.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: The plan has been approved for execution.

executing.label: Executing
executing.description: The system is executing this plan right now: orders are actively being processed.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: The production plan has been fully executed.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: The plan has been closed; no further changes are available.

placed.label: Placed
placed.description: The order has been created and sent to the supplier.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: The order has been cancelled and will not be fulfilled.

received.label: Received
received.description: The order has been fully received.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: The supplier has not yet confirmed supply for this line.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: The supplier confirmed supply for this line.

inTransit.label: In transit
inTransit.description: The shipment for this line is in delivery.

delivered.label: Delivered
delivered.description: The item has been delivered and received.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: The order line has been cancelled.

created.label: Created
created.description: The controlled procurement action has been created in the system based on the approved request.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: The recommendation passed structural validation and is ready for review.

planned.label: Planned
planned.description: The order is planned; execution has not started.

released.label: Released
released.description: The order has been released to production.

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: The alternative has been proposed; no decision has been made yet.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: The alternative has been approved for use.

approvalRequestCreated.label: Approval request created
approvalRequestCreated.description: A user created an approval request for a controlled action.

approvalApproved.label: Approval approved
approvalApproved.description: An authorized user approved the request.

approvalRejected.label: Approval rejected
approvalRejected.description: An authorized user rejected the request.

procurementTaskCreationAttempted.label: Procurement action creation attempted
procurementTaskCreationAttempted.description: The system began creating the controlled procurement action.

procurementTaskCreated.label: Procurement action created
procurementTaskCreated.description: The controlled procurement action was created successfully.

procurementTaskCreationFailed.label: Procurement action creation failed
procurementTaskCreationFailed.description: The attempt to create the controlled action ended with an error.

approvalRequest.label: Approval request
approvalRequest.description: An entity associated with an approval request.

procurementTask.label: Procurement action
procurementTask.description: An entity associated with a controlled procurement action.

userAction.label: User action
userAction.description: A step performed by a user in the interface.

deterministicCalculation.label: Deterministic calculation
deterministicCalculation.description: A result computed by the deterministic engine without an AI model.

retrieval.label: Retrieval
retrieval.description: Searching the knowledge base for relevant documents.

modelCall.label: Model call
modelCall.description: A request to the language model and its response.

structuredValidation.label: Structured validation
structuredValidation.description: Checking the model response against a defined schema.

recommendation.label: Recommendation
recommendation.description: The generated and persisted recommendation about the risk.

approvalRequest.label: Approval request
approvalRequest.description: The created approval request for a controlled action.

humanDecision.label: Human decision
humanDecision.description: An authorized user made a decision.

writeAction.label: Write action
writeAction.description: The execution of a controlled write action in the system.

value.label: Unknown status
value.description: The system has no explanation for this value. The technical code has been preserved for diagnosis.
